# Synthetic DICOM fixtures

Small files in `synthetic/` generated by [radspider](https://github.com/rad-medica/radspider)
(`radspider-synth`, `synth_documents`). They contain no patient data: every
image samples a mathematical phantom and every name/ID is synthetic
(`SYNTH^...`).

| File | Source | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| MR16_ELE.dcm | codecs/ELE | Explicit VR Little Endian, 16-bit |
| MR16_ILE.dcm | codecs/ILE | Implicit VR Little Endian |
| MR16_EBE.dcm | codecs/EBE | Explicit VR Big Endian (OW pixels) |
| CT16S_DEFL.dcm | codecs/DEFL | Deflated Explicit VR Little Endian |
| CT16S_RLE.dcm | codecs/RLE | RLE Lossless |
| CT12_J2KR.dcm | codecs/J2KR | JPEG 2000 Lossless |
| XR8_JPBL.dcm | codecs/JPBL | JPEG Baseline |
| CT12_JPLL.dcm | codecs/JPLL | JPEG Lossless SV1 |
| CT12_JLSL.dcm | codecs/JLSL | JPEG-LS Lossless |
| PET_SUV.dcm | p1-oncology/pet | PET with Radiopharmaceutical Information Sequence |
| VR_UN.dcm | p4-projection/vr-un | Standard attributes stored with VR UN |
| SR_report.dcm | objects/report.dcm | Structured Report |
| KOS.dcm | objects/key_images.dcm | Key Object Selection |
| PDF.dcm | objects/report_pdf.dcm | Encapsulated PDF |

Regenerate with:

```bash
cargo run --release -p radspider-synth -- <dir>/synth
cargo run --release --example synth_documents -- <dir>/objects 128 40
```
